scenario: Payouts integration guide (Markdown) judged against semantic acceptance criteria

criteria.title: OAuth2 token
criteria.description: Explains how to obtain an OAuth2 access token from the PayPal Sandbox: a client-credentials POST to the /v1/oauth2/token endpoint with the app's client id and secret, and that the token expires and must be requested again.

criteria.title: Payout item status
criteria.description: Explains that an accepted Payouts batch is not proof of payment and that each item's final transaction_status (SUCCESS, UNCLAIMED, FAILED, RETURNED ...) must be read back from PayPal per recipient.

criteria.title: Safe retry
criteria.description: Describes how to retry a payout after a timeout without paying twice: reuse the same sender_batch_id (PayPal refuses a duplicate) and read PayPal's record before sending anything new.

criteria.title: Sandbox and secrets
criteria.description: States that the guide targets the Sandbox (api-m.sandbox.paypal.com) and that client secrets are kept in environment variables, never committed to the repository.
